source: A Mixture-of-Experts layer is easy to summarize as “route each token to a few experts.” That sentence is correct, but it hides nearly every engineering and mathematical detail that makes modern ZXNAME0000XZ models interesting.
zh: 专家混合层很容易概括为“将每个代币路由给几个专家”。这句话是正确的，但它隐藏了几乎所有使现代 ZXNAME0000XZ 模型变得有趣的工程和数学细节。
